Name: Tsundere Wizard Marriage Mod by babybird2 English translation
Author: isari112
Description:
This is a poorly-made English translation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7139]this[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57235912]babybird2[/url], so I recommend reading it for more information about what's in this mod. :)

Please note that I am not an English speaker NOR Chinese speaker, so I was mostly accepting help from my friends (and translators) in order to translate this mod for my own needs, I just felt like sharing it, because I thought that some people might want it as well. :)

Pls don't really comment on my poor English skills, I was mostly just putting everything in google translate and then fixing it to sound good, it's possible that I missed something or mistranslated something, feel free to fix any typos, etc. yourself. Also, let me know if something doesn't work (like an event or something) It's a pretty old mod and it seems to me that it works correctly for me, but I can't be sure.

Instructions:
1. Check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7139]original mod[/url] and read the description!
2. Download the translation
3. Download the required mods if you don't have them
4. Put it all in your mods folder
5. Have fun! :)
